en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a satirical scene: three figures representing a priest, a German or Austro‑Hungarian officer, and a Russian officer are fleeing in panic across a landscape with a church spire and town silhouettes in the background. On the right, a smiling peasant or soldier with a rifle over his shoulder waves goodbye. The caption at the bottom right reads "UZ NEREDZEŠANOS!" and the initials "K.B." appear in the lower right corner.
